speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

ocelle-story.name: One Phase: Implement, Review, Fix
ocelle-story.description: Implements one tasks.md phase, then runs independent review and fix rounds until the review approves (at most three), and asks the operator when it does not

ocelle-implement.name: Implement by User Story with Review Rounds
ocelle-implement.description: Runs the implement, review and fix loop for every tasks.md phase that still needs work, one phase at a time, in tasks.md order

ocelle-sdd.name: Ocelle SDD Cycle with Story Reviews
ocelle-sdd.description: specify → plan → tasks → analyze with operator gates, then implements by user story with review and fix rounds after each
